info.title: trainmaps Development API
info.description:
[Vollständige Dokumentation](/dokumentation) · [Schnellstart](/dokumentation/schnellstart) · [API-Anleitung](/dokumentation/api)

Versioned data imports and a separately managed line-reference catalog. Use frontend-2 for stable trainmaps line IDs and basemap.de geometry mappings.

get.description: Catalog of stable line IDs. Data suppliers use these IDs in frontend-2.

put.description: Create or revise a line mapping. Only the dedicated mapping token is accepted.

post.description: Legacy import without stable line IDs. It remains readable but never map-ready.

429.description: Rate limit or another import in progress

post.description: Preferred import. Every source line must resolve to a catalog line_id.

get.description: Retrieve exact original JSON bytes, latest revision or a pinned import ID.
